events.comment: SCENE WIN  |  Hasil stage dimasukkan ke atribut permanen: Chip sesi -> Chip, Kepingan Data (tiap 3 keping = 1 Catatan Lab + 50 XP), XP -> Level Hunter. Stage berikutnya terbuka lalu progres disimpan.

parameters: "Chip Data      +" + ToString(GlobalVariable(HasilChip)) + NewLine() + "Kepingan Data  +" + ToString(GlobalVariable(HasilKeping)) + "  (Catatan Lab +" + ToString(Variable(CatatanBaru)) + ")" + NewLine() + "Kuis benar     " + ToString(GlobalVariable(KuisBenar)) + "/2" + NewLine() + "Level Hunter   " + ToString(GlobalVariable(LevelHunter)) + "   XP " + ToString(GlobalVariable(XP)) + "/100" + NewLine() + "Komponen IoT   " + ToString(GlobalVariable(StageSelesai)) + "/6"
